regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, one-narrative market: Banks are the sole eligible leader with very high durability and complete single-theme dominance, but the trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (it mean-reverts), so the validated drawdown edge is absent here and the tape whipsaws trend signals. Coal is the only other eligible name and the sole challenger, with everything else ineligible — a leadership-concentrated, low-breadth regime where the detector is display-only, not predictive.
emerging_watch: Watching Bank dominance for an absorption breakdown: if breadth_of_rotation.frac (currently 0.09) rises above 0.30 with Coal or another theme turning eligible and durability crossing 0.7, that would retire the one-narrative read and mark a confirmed broadening. No new theme is credible to watch until eligibility expands.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole eligible leader with the highest durability (0.83) and complete breadth (1.0), meaning the theme has internal cohesion and a trend tag. The lean rests on durable, confirmed leadership in a one-narrative tape — not on momentum rank, which is rank-IC ~0. Crowding (z=1.85) and one-narrative dominance argue for a capped, humility-sized directional lean only, since the mean-reverting character of this market undermines the trend gate that would otherwise protect the position.
evidence: durability_bar 0.83 and hurst_tag 'trend' — the only strong-trend eligible theme
crowding_z 1.85, crowded=true — sizing caution, not a fade
theses.dissent: This is a mean-reverting tape where the trend gate historically failed to reduce drawdown, so a durable-looking leader can whipsaw sharply; complete one-narrative dominance with crowding at z=1.85 often marks late-stage attention concentration rather than fresh entry opportunity.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms the CSI 300 benchmark by 5% total return before 2026-11-03

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only challenger to Banks and the second of only two eligible themes, but its durability is materially lower (0.55 vs 0.83), breadth is half (0.5), and its hurst_tag is mean-revert — the opposite of trend continuity in a market already flagged as mean-reverting. The rotation margin to Banks is thin (0.04) but the handoff is not confirmed, and coal's own trend-health is weak, so a relative underweight vs the dominant theme is the honest lean.
evidence: durability_bar 0.55, hurst_tag 'mean-revert' — weaker trend health than Banks
breadth 0.5 — only half participation vs Banks' 1.0
rotation.margin 0.04 with directional=false — no confirmed handoff
rotation.breadth_of_rotation frac 0.09 — leadership is narrow, not broadening
theses.dissent: If the one-narrative Banks regime stalls, Coal is the only other eligible beneficiary of rotation and could absorb flow; its relative value/cyclical profile may be the cleanest expression of a value rotation that Banks has already crowded into.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners score third but are ineligible with zero breadth (0.0) and a middling durability (0.3) that is not trend-confirmed. Ineligible means the absolute-trend gate — the only validated edge in this system — does not support exposure here. With no ETF proxy (unscorable) and no participation, there is no accountable basis for a directional lean.
evidence: scorable=false — no proxy to grade the call against
never fabricate a level or trigger for an unscorable theme with no breadth
theses.dissent: Gold could act as a safe-haven diversifier outside the narrow financials-value leadership, but the detector shows no current trend health or participation to justify exposure.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners becomes eligible with breadth above 0.5 and a durable trend tag before 2026-11-03
